data.name: Idle Chibi Knight
data.detailed_description:
Family Matters

As with the original Chibi Knight series, this game is a family endeavor. Nick's kids (now age 7-13) contribute concept art, story, boss and gameplay ideas throughout development. You'll even hear their voice acting directly in the game!


About the Game

Idle Chibi Knight carries on the legacy of Chibi Knight in an epic, idle dungeon crawling adventure. This casual RPG experience combines dungeon crawling, ARPG combat, and passive incremental progression. Fight monsters, acquire loot, level up and grow increasingly powerful.

Play as multiple classes, and experiment with different builds and skill combinations. Invest in multiple attributes to find your preferred stat balance. Amass Beast Orbs to fight by your side as the Beast Master, or wield powerful elemental magic as the Sorcerer. Plus 3 all-new classes, never before seen in the Chibi Knight series!

Set in the Kingdom of Oukoku. A family-friendly, charming world filled with goofy fantasy characters and creatures. This includes a cast of familiar characters and returning favorites from previous Chibi Knight games, silly new additions, and cheeky references to other games and bits of pop culture.
